killedBy: modal isolation: a blocking overlay is really modal (issue #327) does NOT trap a route, because a full-screen destination is not a dialog
why: Traps every layer rather than the blocking kind, so opening Settings or Records isolates the rest of the HUD. That strands a player in a full-screen destination whose only exit is a Back button the trap keeps them from reaching -- strictly worse than the defect this feature fixes. `navigation.ts` already draws the line (an overlay is the blocking kind, and a route may not be pushed over one), which is why this reads the stack's own answer instead of inventing a second notion of "is a dialog". It also failed the issue-#494 Escape-at-slider case until PR #1080 moved that case to Settings: the case opened Customize and focused the slider on the hidden Settings pane, which the trap made inert. Only an older jsdom focused a hidden control at all, so that kill said nothing about routes, and the case no longer claims it.
